title: Bug: Vxlan netdev name crosses IFNAMSIZ and creation fails
author: fountzou
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Vxlan netdev creation fails when the length of vxlan_dev_name crosses IFNAMSIZ. This has been noted as part of the testcase vxlan/test_vxlan_decap.py::test_vxlan_decap. 
Related (sonic-buildimage) Issue: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/10466

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Run the test.
2. Manually via cmd 
`sudo /sbin/ip link add tunnelVxlan-1000 address e8:f3:75:8d:90:50 type vxlan id 1336 local 10.1.0.32 remote 8.8.8.8 nolearning dstport 4789`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The current output is: `Error: Attribute failed policy validation.`
Expectation is to proceed without this Error.

### Relevant log output

```
swss#vxlanmgrd: :- createVxlanNetdevice: Creating VxlanNetDevice tunnelVxlan-1000
swss#supervisord: vxlanmgrd Error: Attribute failed policy validation.
swss#vxlanmgrd: :- exec: /bin/bash -c "/sbin/ip link add tunnelVxlan-1000 address e8:f3:75:8d:90:50 type vxlan id 1336 local 10.1.0.32 remote 8.8.8.8 nolearning  dstport 4789  && /sbin/ip link set tunnelVxlan-1000 master Bridge  && /sbin/bridge vlan add vid 1000 dev tunnelVxlan-1000 && /sbin/bridge vlan add vid 1000 untagged pvid dev tunnelVxlan-1000 && /sbin/bridge vlan del vid 1 dev tunnelVxlan-1000 && /sbin/ip link set tunnelVxlan-1000 up " :  : Exited with rc=2
swss#vxlanmgrd: :- doVxlanTunnelMapCreateTask: Vxlan Net Dev creation failure for tunnelVxlan VNI(1336) VLAN(1000)
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell

```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_
